test_title: PYST 36: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
What would be the Roman numeral on the opposite side of ‘V’ if the given sheet is folded to form a cube? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ef8352986857dec68a72cd4ab0e9d25cbeb49e9f4e426f1d2b9137d25ee688b.png]
solution:
The faces opposite to each other are shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e18847540d9861ab6df236278399bfaac7cb254b20533516486c1f2fa91d2826.png] 

⇒ As the alternate positions become opposite to each other, the remaining two faces become opposite to each other.

So, opposite pairs are:

V → VIII

VI → X

IX → VII

Therefore, 'VIII' is the opposite of 'V'.

Hence, "VIII" is the correct answer.
